FN-5QCHMM6-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 126
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Robert Stewart
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 126 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Liquefied Petroleum
Gas Board until October 1, 2028 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not
otherwise affect state or local funding.

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 126
Committee: ENACTED Sponsor: Senator Robert Stewart
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 06/07/2024
Senate Bill 126 (Act 2024-148) as enacted provides for the continuance of the Alabama
Liquefied Petroleum Gas Board until October 1, 2028 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. The
provisions of this act will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
